note: Chunk 2 Task 24b conformance case list, loaded by WidgetSiteLayoutApiConformanceTest. This file is NOT the frozen API contract (that is widget-site-layout-api-contract.json, produced by Task 12 and never edited by this gate) -- it is a declarative role/route matrix the LIVE conformance test cross-checks against the live HTTP API. Every one of the 30 frozen routes is exercised with Webmaster (must never see 403) and a denied user (must always see exactly 403 WIDGET_PERMISSION_DENIED); this file adds the additional named privilege-inheritance boundaries the task brief calls out by name (editor/publisher/approver/emergency responder), so a route-permission regression is caught by DATA, not only by hand-written PHP assertions.
role_source_note: editor/publisher permission sets are copied verbatim from WidgetPilotAuthorizationContractTest's own frozen EDITOR_KEYS/PUBLISHER_KEYS constants (Chunk 1 Task 12b) for cross-suite consistency, not reinvented here.

every_route_matrix.applies_to: every route in the frozen contract's routes[] array

privilege_inheritance_checks.reason: editor holds widget_layout.update/preview but never publish
editor holds widget_layout.update/preview but never rollback
publisher holds publish/rollback but never widget_template.approve
approver holds only widget_template.approve, never widget_instance.create

no_get_side_effect_routes.note: bootstrap owns creation via PUT /layouts/by-key/{layout_key} only; a GET must never create a Layout

project_limited_role.reason: Single active-project mode (Task 5a freeze, re-confirmed by WidgetPilotAuthorizationContractTest's own docblock: 'no real project-scoped RBAC exists... No project-limited role is fabricated'). WidgetProjectContextResolver derives the project server-side from config('ispa-cms.folder_name'); no route in the frozen contract accepts a client-supplied project selector (the materialize route's own forbidden_request_fields explicitly bans project_name/project). The only reachable project-isolation surface is WidgetProjectContextResolver::assertProject() rejecting a caller-supplied mismatching name, already proven at Task 12/12b -- this gate re-asserts the STRUCTURAL reason (no route accepts a project selector at all) rather than fabricating a role with no data-model support.
